findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.assumptions: The filename 'grades' is hardcoded and not attacker-controlled. However, if the filename were derived from user input, this would be a potential vulnerability.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If 'first' or 'last' contains malicious input, it could be used to inject commands.
findings.assumptions: The 'first' and 'last' variables are derived from user input. If they are not, this vulnerability does not apply.

findings.title: Improper Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime
findings.trigger: Memory allocated with 'malloc' is not checked for failure.
findings.assumptions: The 'malloc' calls could fail if there is insufficient memory, leading to undefined behavior.
